implementation.barPaint: Procedural colored rectangles use17 horizontal x15 vertical coverage samples and one final tint per rectangle. A left-boundary sample exactly on the edge is excluded, the right boundary includes it. Horizontal positions, widths, baseline, palette, fractional edges/corners and painter order are fixed; only vertical heights are random.
implementation.rotatedText: The actual native FreeType trace selected Liberation Sans Regular13px, loadflags0x130200, matrix[46340,-46340,46340,46340], zero glyph-cache delta and LCD mode3. Cached glyph positions use ceil in device space; red-channel coverages add with saturation before one foreground51 tint. Native P bitmap120 bytes matches the pinned FreeType2.13.2 WASM, SHAef5765380075e522853a90f9f2b064ceacdc9bd5e15d5f0fadca037893c806a3. Shared face transform is restored after load, including failures; prior normal43px output before/after rotation and rejection stays identical.
implementation.sourceSemantics: Native export removes Font/BackColor/BorderColor. Requested fonts do not affect this chart preview. ReadOnly/Enabled change the outer border160->232. Source XML is preserved. Complete typed applicability and computed inspector remain open.
implementation.capture: Each accepted reference verifies exact160x23 form header RGB/name, waits2sec then requires two consecutive equal complete-control captures. Height493 uses visible native viewports with equal overlap and full bottom border. Inactive-header preliminaryRUFont12 capture is preserved/excluded. No source writes or BSL.
implementation.randomValuePolicy: The native default reopened with22352 changed pixels. Independent Python renderer reproduces all24 complete native RGB surfaces using scalar observed height bins. It then changes only heights to the existing captured demonstration values. For every bar, the exact union of native/viewer vertical extents includes fractional edge coverage; all pixels outside those unions are exactly equal. The installed UI is compared in full, including all bar edges/fills, to these independent recomposed oracles. Thus no axis/text/legend/palette/width/bottom is masked, and missing or malformed bars fail. Complete native random-value equality is not claimed.
implementation.lifecycle: Dirty XML changes dimensions, requested fonts/colors and inactive states while preserving control DOM and selected identity. A real floating about:blank VS Code window receives tall/small updates and reattaches. Source bytes remain unchanged.
implementation.scopeGate: Linux/DPR1/zoom100/en-US culture, the two recordedru/en label sets and five recorded metric pairs. Other conditions retain browser fallback with the existing localized notice. Full-property/style/dimension/culture matrices and full forms remain open.
